## Exercise 4

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

data("penguins")

glimpse(penguins)
summary(penguins)
```

```{r}
adelie <- penguins %>% filter(species == "Adelie")

ggplot(adelie, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Adelie penguins: bill length vs bill depth",
    x = "Bill length (mm)",
    y = "Bill depth (mm)"
  )
```

```{r}
penguins %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(bill_length_mm)),
    mean_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bill_length = median(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bill_length = sd(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
penguins_long <- penguins %>%
  select(species, bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm, flipper_length_mm, body_mass_g) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-species, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

ggplot(penguins_long, aes(x = species, y = value, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Value")
```
